svg.title: Four graphs: (c) from (-4,5) down to (-1,2), up to (2,4), down to (5,1); (d) from (-2,2) down to (-1,1), up to (2,4), then falling without bound beside a dashed vertical line; (e) from (-4,3) down to (-2,0), up to (0,5), down to (3,1), then rising without bound beside a dashed vertical line; (f) a curve with closed endpoints whose low and high turning points, including (5,5), are open circles.
